additional_info.subject: ID0460147-DC/Si-D/UK-[multi] Outlets out of order. CRM:03042000147
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0460147
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-GB SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2/T5314234864005
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
Following your report and after our check and analysis, we can see that out of the 4 charger IDs you reported:
Charger 1wNN19 shows one error flag: Converter problem
First, check the
cables attached to that converter. If they are properly connected, proceed to the next step.
Try swapping the converter that shows the issue with the one beside it. This will help confirm whether the problem lies in the cables or in the converter itself. If the issue remains after swapping, it confirms that the converter itself is faulty. In that case, replace the converter.
Charger 8yrzvw shows two error flags: PT1000_BT3_Automation and PaymentTerminalUnreachable_PZx
We suspect that this error flag might have raised because of one or more of the following issues:
Filters of the charger might be clogged or have a lot of dust.
The temperature is hot and is making the temperature raise a lot inside the charger.
Sensors not measuring/working correctly.
Issue with Fan rotation.
need to check the following things onsite-
Check if filters are clear. Filters of the charger might be clogged or have a lot of dust.
Check if the Fan is rotating properly?
Check whether Sensors measuring/working correctly or not.
Also need to check the electrical connections of FAN and sensors.
we always need to make sure is that the measuremnent of the sensor = 1kOhm
Check the connections - terminal blocks, connectors and loose wirings as per the diagram below (For BT3). Because sometimes faulty connectors or loose connections also causes the issue.
If BT3 found to be healthy then only we need to check for KF6 module as per the diagram above.
For the
PaymentTerminalUnreachable_PZx
Please make sure the terminal is properly commissioned after reconnecting.
If all these steps fail, proceed with replacing the terminal.
I will send the reference number of the replacement payment terminal
8EM5903-0AA02-7AA1 -PZ2 Credit Card Reader CCV Contactless
8EM5903-0AA02-5AA7 -PZ3 Processing Unit CCV Set 24M - CCV KNB
The remaining two chargers show no error flags from our side
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-GB SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Younes Baroudi
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
